formula: log(cost) ~ log(output) + log(fuelprice) + loadf + (1 | airline) + (1 | year)
notes: Exercise 9.2, step 2 fits log costs with logged output and fuel price and crossed airline/year intercepts.

formula: anti ~ pov + momage + female + childage + hispanic + black + momwork + married + (1 | id)
notes: ex5_2_anti.do fits a Gaussian random-intercept model including Hispanic and Black indicators; anti is a bounded integer score.

formula: wbeing ~ cohes + lead + hrs + (1 | grp)
notes: Exercise 4.5, step 1 explicitly fits the recorded Gaussian random-intercept model.

formula: weight ~ gender + age + I(age^2) + (age | id)
notes: Read ch7.do: mixed weight i.gender age c.age#c.age || id: age, covariance(unstructured). Random intercept + slope on age, quadratic age. Weights of Asian children over occasions; brthwt and occ unused by this model.
Exercise 7.4, step 3 fits treatment-specific growth in years with correlated subject intercepts and time slopes.

formula: log(c) ~ log(100 * price / CPI) + log(100 * NDI / CPI) + log(100 * pimin / CPI) + year + (1 | state) + (1 | year)
notes: Exercise 9.9, step 2 fits logged consumption and CPI-deflated logged prices/income, a fixed year trend, and crossed state/year intercepts.

formula: use ~ urban + age + children + educ + hindu + d_lit + d_pray + (1 | district)
notes: Women within districts, from Bangladesh (MLwiN manual): 2,867 rows in 60 districts, distinct from Stata's 1,934-row bangladesh. use binary, method the nominal contraceptive type; woman a row id, cons a constant, d_lit/d_pray district covariates. Hand pass #82: exercise 12.5 fits the nominal method, traditional methods excluded, with two correlated district intercepts across its categories, a categorical likelihood outside the contract; the filed use formula is a surrogate and is refused.

formula: choice ~ display + feature + price + brand + (1 | id)
notes: Read help (brand labels); no do-file model. Cracker-brand discrete choice, four alternatives (brand) per occasion (occ) per household (id); choice the chosen alternative. Conditional-choice model rendered with a household random intercept; model inferred. Hand pass #82: refused as a choice model: the rows form 2,509 four-brand choice sets indexed by (id, occ), one chosen alternative each, and the source fits conditional and mixed multinomial choice, from which a household intercept cancels.

formula: cornhec ~ cornpix + soypix + (1 | county)
notes: Exercise 3.9, step 1 explicitly fits the corn-hectares Gaussian model with both satellite predictors and a county intercept.

formula: fscr ~ log(cfs) + heifer + ai + (1 | herd) + (1 | cow)
notes: Exercise 16.1, step 2 fits first-service conception using log calving-to-first-service interval, insemination type and heifer status, with herd/cow intercepts.

formula: ufr ~ tmp * factor(center) + (1 + tmp | subject)
notes: Exercise 4.6 fits center-specific fixed intercepts and pressure slopes with correlated subject intercepts/slopes, by REML. These are 164 low-flux measurements on 41 subjects at three centers, distinct from Stata's nonlinear dialyzer example.

formula: profmath ~ w1sesl + numrisks + male + s4pupri + (1 | s4_id)
notes: Read help labels (profmath = ordinal proficiency, prof45 = dichotomised, s4_id = school id); no do-file model. ECLS-K children within schools (s4_id); profmath ordinal (3-5). childid a row id, prof45 the binary alternate outcome. Hand pass #82: refused: exercise 11.9 merges ecls_school, collapses proficiency categories 0/1 and fits I(pmax(profmath, 1)) ~ numrisks + nbhoodcl + pubpriv2 + (1 | s4_id) by cumulative logit; nbhoodcl is not in the child table and pubpriv2 = s4pupri - 1. The filed child-only formula stays unpublished.

formula: grade ~ factor(grader) + (1 | essay)
notes: Chapter 11.10 fits an eight-category grade response with grader fixed effects, an essay intercept and cumulative-probit likelihood; grader-specific measurement-error variances belong to the separate chapter 11.11 extension.

formula: bwt ~ parity + mothage + male + (1 | family)
notes: Mother–father–child families, member the within-family index; bwt birthweight, first/birthyr/midage/highage derived. Hand pass #82: exercise 4.7 (equation 4.5) fits three independent family coefficients with a shared variance on mother/child and father/child weighted indicators, without a random intercept, a constrained genetic covariance the family-intercept formula does not hold; refused.

formula: gcse ~ lrt + (1 | school)
notes: Read ch4.do: mixed gcse lrt || school:, mle (first model; a random-slope || school: lrt variant and a schgend##lrt model follow, same response and grouping). Students within schools, lrt the reading-test covariate; student a row id. girl/schgend/avslrt/schav/vrband available but not in the first model.
Read ch9.do: mixed I F C || _all: R.fn || yr:, reml (crossed firm fn and year yr). Grunfeld investment panel; I investment, F market value, C capital. firmname duplicates fn.

formula: immun ~ kid2p + indNoSpa + indSpa + momEdPri + momEdSec + husEdPri + husEdSec + husEdDK + rural + pcInd81 + (1 | cluster) + (1 | mom)
notes: Read ch16.do: melogit immun kid2p indNoSpa indSpa momEdPri momEdSec husEdPri husEdSec husEdDK rural pcInd81 || cluster: || mom:, intpoints(15). Three-level Guatemalan child-immunisation data (Rodriguez-Goldman), children within mothers within communities (cluster). kid a row id; mom25p/order*/momWork available but not in the first model.

formula: lnhr ~ lnwg + kids + ageh + I(ageh^2) + disab + (1 | id)
notes: Exercise 5.5, step 2 explicitly fits this Gaussian random-intercept model; agesq is the precomputed square of ageh.

formula: chosen ~ price + cost + range + electric + gas + hybrid + highperf + medhiperf + (1 | id)
notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: stated-preference car-choice conjoint; respondent id makes repeated choice situations, chosen (0/1) the picked alternative. Mixed/conditional logit with a respondent random intercept; situation is the choice-set id. No labels. Hand pass #82: refused as a choice model: the rows form 1,484 three-car choice sets, one chosen alternative each, and the source fits multinomial choice with correlated respondent coefficients on electric and hybrid, gas the reference, and no common respondent intercept.

formula: ravens ~ treatment * relyear + age_at_time0 + boy + (1 | schoolid) + (1 | schoolid:id)
notes: Chapter 8.12.3 fits a Gaussian three-level random-intercept model to the bounded integer Raven score; no binomial trials are documented.

formula: close ~ I(1 - husband) + I(lmarr * husband) + I(lmarr * (1 - husband)) + (1 | couple)
notes: Exercise 11.6, step 3b models five-level closeness using a wife indicator, separate husband/wife marriage-duration slopes and a couple intercept, with cumulative-probit likelihood.
